title: When the Winter Sings
author: E. M. Marchetti
blurb: Wren Blackwood, a pest controller called to something with fingerprints, doesn't believe, has never believed, will not begin believing now. But when all the photographs from grandma's house now include an extra chair, they discover that staying invisible was never really an option. Now they must get the family out ahead of the count, and time is already running out.
style: vivid, cinematic prose with tight pacing
